newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon sees CompUSA rebounding.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon sees CompUSA rebounding.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it sees CompUSA Inc's business rebounding strongly in January.
-- said same-store sales or "comps" have rebounded "dramatically" from the 10 percent decline seen in the last two weeks of December.
-- said recent sales strength has been in both the direct and retail segments.
-- said selling at half its 30 percent projected growth rate, this stock is currently offering a "compelling risk/reward relationship."
-- CompUSA gained 3-3/8 to 17-1/2 in afternoon trading.
-- Salomon analyst David Childe said he rated CompUSA a strong buy.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
